def transform(grid):
    """Combine the two binary panels on either side of the vertical divider.

    A cell is marked when both corresponding panel cells are occupied.
    """
    # Find the uniform nonzero separator column between the panels.
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
                   if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    if not left or len(left[0]) != len(right[0]):
        raise ValueError("Expected equally sized panels separated by one column")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]

def transform(grid):
    """Overlay equal-sized binary panels separated by a uniform row.

    Mark cells with 2 where both aligned cells in the panels are nonzero.
    """
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if row and all(value == row[0] for value in row)
                   and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom) or not top:
        raise ValueError("Expected equal-height panels separated by one row")
    if any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(top, bottom)):
        raise ValueError("Expected equal-width panels")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
